title: Nabbe second ka gussa
banner:
Meeting ke beech
90 second ka bat 🏏
caption:
Din bhar ka tanaav nikalne ka aapka tareeka kya hai? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a woman who plays Break Room, a 90-second bat-swinging game in Waypoint, between meetings. For adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Mia: Mia is a young professional woman in her late twenties with a ponytail, a white shirt and a lanyard.
cast.Colleague: The colleague is a friendly man in a grey blazer carrying a laptop.

scenes.vo: मीया की सुबह से तीन मीटिंग हो चुकी थीं।
scenes.sub: Mia ki subah se teen meeting ho chuki thi.
scenes.art: Mia in an office meeting room with a laptop, tired eyes, a whiteboard full of notes behind her.

scenes.vo: चौथी में पाँच मिनट बाक़ी थे।
scenes.sub: Chauthi mein paanch minute baaki the.
scenes.art: Mia in a small corridor holding a coffee cup, a wall clock showing five minutes to the hour.

scenes.vo: सिर भारी था, कंधे अकड़े हुए।
scenes.sub: Sir bhaari tha, kandhe akde hue.
scenes.art: Mia rolling her stiff shoulders and rubbing her neck near a window.

scenes.vo: उसने वेपॉइंट खोला, बैट वाला आइकन दबाया।
scenes.sub: Usne Waypoint khola, bat wala icon dabaya.
scenes.art: Mia opening an app on her phone with a mischievous smile, leaning against a corridor wall.

scenes.vo: बैट घुमाओ, कमरे की चीज़ें टूटती हैं।
scenes.sub: Bat ghumao, kamre ki cheezein tootti hain.

scenes.vo: नब्बे सेकंड, दिन में एक बार।
scenes.sub: Nabbe second, din mein ek baar.

scenes.vo: पहली स्विंग पर टीवी चटक गया।
scenes.sub: Pehli swing par TV chatak gaya.
scenes.art: Mia swinging an imaginary bat in the air in the corridor, a cartoon TV cracking inside a floating illustrated bubble above her phone.

scenes.vo: आवाज़ और हल्का कंपन, मन हल्का होने लगा।
scenes.sub: Awaaz aur halka kampan, man halka hone laga.
scenes.art: Mia laughing with her eyes closed, little sparkle lines around her phone.

scenes.vo: नब्बे सेकंड बाद कमरा बंद, खेल ख़त्म।
scenes.sub: Nabbe second baad kamra band, khel khatam.
scenes.art: Mia lowering her phone with a deep calm breath, straightening her shoulders.

scenes.vo: वो हल्की मुस्कान के साथ मीटिंग में लौटी।
scenes.sub: Woh halki muskaan ke saath meeting mein lauti.
scenes.art: Mia walking back into the meeting room smiling, a colleague holding the door.
Close-up of Mia smiling warmly at the viewer, office corridor softly blurred behind.
